Definition: Malcam or Milcom, the national idol of the Ammonites
BiblicalUsage: Milcom = "great king"; 1) the god of the Ammonites and Phoenicians to whom some Israelites sacrificed their infants in the valley of Hinnom; 1a) also 'Molech'; 2) a Benjamite, son of Shaharaim by his wife Hodesh
